links.outcome: Cross-institutional performance degradation of mortality prediction under distribution shift
links.effect: Framework reported to demonstrate robust generalization under cross-institutional distribution shifts, mitigating performance degradation; no numbers given in abstract.
links.quote: Moreover, the proposed framework demonstrated robust generalization under cross-institutional distribution shifts, effectively mitigating the performance degradation commonly observed in multicenter settings.

unlisted_practices: LLM-guided synthetic data augmentation with semantic regularization for prediction model training
Clinician-centered evaluation of synthetic sample clinical fidelity

screen.reason: The paper introduces MAGMED, an LLM-guided synthetic data augmentation framework for ICU mortality prediction, evaluates it across centers including clinician evaluations, and integrates it into hospital workflow, but does not compare outcomes with vs without an organizational deployment practice/guardrail.
